title: Vesper and the Asset
author: August Brightwater
blurb: Noor Underhill, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
